blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has disbursed P677.8 million so far under its Uplift Disaster Assistance Program to assist small sugarcane farmers and laborers across the Negros Island Region (NIR) affected by the red-stripe soft-scale insect infestation. DSWD-NIR Regional Director Arwin Razo said the agency’s Disaster Response Operations Monitoring and Information Center (DROMIC) data released as of October 24 showed that the ongoing disaster assistance initiative has provided financial relief to 66,005 beneficiaries: 56,301 sugarcane farmers and 9,704 sugarcane laborers in Negros Island. Negros Occidental accounted for the largest aid distribution, with 47,497 beneficiaries receiving P490,406,525 in […]...
